description: Merged over rjwalters/repo policies/default.json and deployed to 2AMLogic/.github:renovate-config by /repo:org-policy --install.
Update delays (minimumReleaseAge) come from default.json and are not restated here: one definition.

dependencyDashboard false: every 2AMLogic fleet repo runs Loom, whose Curator treats the unlabelled dashboard issue as work (rjwalters/loom#9418). A repo that wants one extends :dependencyDashboard after this preset.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: one PR for every update type, majors included. Workflows here pull a handful of actions; separate bumps are noise.
Package ecosystems: minor and patch grouped per ecosystem; majors stay ungrouped so a breaking change gets its own PR.
The Go language version (go/toolchain directives) is a deliberate pinned step, not a routine bump.
